description: We are a team of ambitious builders participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our mission is to build a real-world Earth science product using NASA data, software engineering, and scientific computing. We're looking for passionate problem-solvers with skills in software development, Python, AI/ML, data science, geospatial technologies, UI/UX, and research. We value curiosity, ownership, teamwork, and execution over titles. Let's build something meaningful.
